paragraphs: As in [Pesachim 113a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.113a.11): Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said in the name of the people of Jerusalem.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi speaks in the name of the people of Jerusalem in the linked statement.
The [preceding passage](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.113a.10) also attributes advice to the people of Jerusalem, through Rabbi Yochanan.
